detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying a divine Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'Ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'Ohs with incredible powers. The Hole Has Spoken!

Break the Hole to extract its impurities!

Use Shelly to drill your way down while managing and caring for your Mini'Ohs.

Find secrets within the Depths, rebuild the Village and grow the community!

Equip your Mini'Ohs to grant them incredible powers. Experiment and find the best combinations!

Keep going down while numbers go up.

Together, we are stronger!

Features

  • Addictive incremental progression.

  • 40~ Depths with dangers and secrets to find.

  • Customize and build your Mini'Ohs with 500+ different equipment combinations.

  • 300+ upgrades to discover.

  • Accompany your Mini'Ohs in the search of truth! (~5.0h of gameplay).

Discord

Join our Discord server to stay up to date with the latest news and share your feedback with us. You can find the link in the sidebar!
